title: “Nice Try, Kiddo”: Investigating Ad Hominems in Dialogue Responses

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the frequency of ad hominem attacks (detected via human annotation and a fine-tuned BERT classifier) in dialogue responses to Twitter posts containing the #BlackLivesMatter hashtag versus non-marginalized baseline topics like #Vegan and #WFH.
